te: Unknown person threw an egg at the Prime Minister of Hungary Magyar
de: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Madyar faced the incident during a meeting with residents of the town of Solnok. An unidentified man threw an egg at the politician, but missed, after which he was detained by police.

te: Astronauts quarantined before Crew Dragon flight
de: Members of the Crew-13 mission’s international space crew have arrived at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida. NASA said the team flew from Houston on Sunday for final preparations for the Oct. 1 launch.

te: Trump called the conflict between Russia and Ukraine the most difficult of all
